notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.
